## Summary
- What changed and why

## Type of Change
- [ ] feat: New feature (backward-compatible)
- [ ] fix: Bug fix (backward-compatible)
- [ ] refactor: Code restructuring (no behavior change)
- [ ] test: Adding/modifying tests
- [ ] docs: Documentation only
- [ ] ci: CI/CD pipeline changes
- [ ] build: Build system changes
- [ ] chore: Maintenance

## Quality Gates
- [ ] All 17 services compile with zero errors
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass
- [ ] Coverage meets thresholds (>80% instruction, >70% branch)
- [ ] No circular dependencies introduced
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities introduced
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets in code
- [ ] Architecture validation (ArchUnit) passes
- [ ] Flyway migrations are ordered correctly (no gaps)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits format

## Verification
- What was tested and how

## Rollback Plan
- How to revert this change if needed
